analysis: The PR changes only docs/architecture/inference.md. The head-side patch (hunk at lines 1584-1592) adds a paragraph on tokenizer decoding. The paragraph says LocalTokenizerLoader resolves an absent clean_up_tokenization_spaces key to false in memory and keeps an explicit Boolean. It states that input IDs, sampling and cache keys do not depend on this setting. The two supplied units are base-text excerpts of unchanged surrounding documentation (lines 3235-4002) and carry no changed lines. I found no change to code, controls, keys, attestation, authorization, encryption or the prefix-cache storage described in T-041. The documented behaviour is a decode-side text-formatting fix. It does not touch the coordinator-to-provider boundary (TB-002), key handling (A-003), or prefix-cache scoping, TTL or HMAC lookup tags. The claim that cache keys are independent of the setting is consistent with T-041, because cache identity derives from token IDs and the coordinator-authored salt. The actual Swift change in LocalTokenizerLoader.swift is not in the supplied evidence, so this is a documentation-only review. A later pass should confirm that the loader code matches the documented behaviour, including that it does not read tokenizer config from an untrusted path and that the streamed-decode repeat fix does not alter the plaintext or encrypted output paths (T-008). No threat-model update is needed for this docs change.
